subject: music

moments.title: Thriller
moments.body: Thriller is the bestselling album of all time, with the title video reshaping pop video as a form.
moments.takeaway: Music and video became inseparable in the 1980s.

moments.title: Like a Virgin
moments.body: Madonna's image and performance reshape what a female pop star looks and sounds like.

moments.title: Jackson dies
moments.body: Jackson's death prompts global mourning and renewed debate over abuse allegations.
moments.takeaway: Pop biographies must hold celebration and harm together.

now.title: Pop now
now.body: Taylor Swift and BTS run touring economies on a national scale. Spotify and TikTok shape what gets heard.
now.open_questions: Who shapes pop now, artists or algorithms?

reflection: Pop has been declared throwaway and survived every generation that said so.
